approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai CFO team (Sterling)

approve_monthly_close.notes: Monthly close package requires Jane's approval before final archive.

approve_forecast.notes: Monthly forecast + quarterly re-forecast require Jane's approval before publication.

approve_pricing_change_small.notes: Pricing changes / discounts at or below 15% off list can be approved by Sterling.

approve_pricing_change_large.notes: Discounts > 15% off list require Sterling + Jane approval. Discounts below cost require strategic rationale documented.

approve_unbudgeted_spend.notes: Spend > $5,000 outside an approved budget requires Jane approval.

approve_external_finance_comm.notes: Any communication to bank, tax authority, or external auditor requires Jane's per-message approval.

document_exception.notes: Garrison documents exceptions immediately; Sterling acknowledges within 24h.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop can be activated immediately by Sterling or Jane.
